name: Investigative / Dossier
visual_language: Serious case file: dark charcoal desk, aged paper, torn-paper photographic cut-outs, taped evidence cards, highlighted passages, red circles and underlines, stamps that separate CONFIRMED, CONVICTED, ACQUITTED and ALLEGED.
image_strategy: Authentic photographs only. Large cut-out of the real subject, then per-claim evidence: a document extract, a dated record, a verified photograph. If no authentic image exists, use a sourced quotation, timeline or extract, never a generated picture.
composition_rules: the subject is large in the opening scene
every scene shows the evidence the sentence is about
the layout changes as the case progresses: cover, document, timeline, allegation card, comparison, record
allegation is always visibly apart from findings
no evidence board that implies guilt by association
transitions: short fades and paper slides; no whip pans, no spins
motion: one slow push-in on the cut-out; evidence cards slide and settle; highlights and circles draw on; stamps land once
evidence_requirements: every photograph has a recorded source and licence
documents are typeset excerpts of fetched text, labelled as excerpts
dates and labels match the sources
a mugshot is used only if genuine, lawfully usable and relevant

music.direction: restrained documentary tension, a low impact on each reveal

story_structure: what it does and does not establish
qa_checks: authentic photographs only and all sourced
no fabricated mugshot, document or headline
narration matches the evidence on screen
